claim: Each bird steers toward its nearest beacon only, and the pull eases off within 2.5 world units of it.
derivation: Only the beacon rule is on (w_b = 1, v* = 2.7). Beacons sit at (5, 6) and (26, 20).
A (5, 5) moving (1, 0): the nearest beacon is (5, 6) at 1 (the other is 18.60 away). Inside r_b = 2.5 the pull eases: desired = 2.7 · (0, 1)/2.5 = (0, 1.08), so B_A = (−1, 1.08) (E6).
B (20, 20) moving (0, 1): the nearest beacon is (26, 20) at 6 (the other is 20.52 away); desired = 2.7 · (6, 0)/6 = (2.7, 0), so B_B = (2.7, −1).
